sloka: यथा श्रुत्वैव नचिरात्तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।सुग्रीवसहितौ वीरावुपेयातां तथा कुरु ।। ५.५८.१०५ ।।।।
transliteration: yathā śrutvaiva nacirāttāvubhau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।sugrīvasahitau vīrāvupeyātāṁ tathā kuru ।। 5.58.105 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O heroic Hanuman narrate in such a way that by hearing you both Rama and Lakshmana will come here soon, accompanied by Sugriva.
